d: Tensions between the United States, Iran and NATO are escalating as Donald Trump's military strategy faces fresh challenges. US warplanes are reportedly retreating amid rising threats from Tehran, raising questions about Washington's next move and the risks of a wider regional conflict. Iran's warning to NATO has added another layer of uncertainty, putting Western allies on alert as the confrontation threatens to expand beyond the Middle East. Will Trump reconsider his military approach? Could Iran's threats draw NATO deeper into the conflict? And what does this mean for global security,…
